name: dest
description: The five destinations: Today, Reflections, Timeline, Ask, You. Always five, always in that order: Reflections next to Today (v4 B7), You set apart from the journal four (revision 28). A compact header row on the web, a column in the desktop title block; never a bottom bar on mobile web. The native app's tab bar keeps its own four until app development starts.

form.description: tab is the native app's tab bar (was .dest.tab): equal cells across the foot of the screen above the home indicator, You divided by a rule (revision 47).

slot.description: true: an empty, aria-hidden date slot (aj-c-dest__slot) before the last link, where a parent (the header's compact state) draws the date; hidden unless the parent asks (--aj-c-dest-slot).

noRule.true: its rules read the part (aj-c-dest__slot), which is rendered only with the variant, not the attribute

current.description: The destination the page belongs to; it carries aria-current="page" and is filled --block. none on a pushed page that sits under no destination.

links.description: Exactly five { label, href, key } in the order Today, Reflections, Timeline, Ask, You (system/content/destinations.mjs); the native tab bar passes its four. Labels are final copy; the CSS sets them in printed caps.

exposes.--aj-c-dest-pad-x: A parent's link padding (inline), over the --s6 / --s7 default.
exposes.--aj-c-dest-size: A parent's link font size, over --t-print.
exposes.--aj-c-dest-transition: A parent's link transition list, over the shell's transform glide (none stops it).
exposes.--aj-c-dest-last-margin: The last link's left margin, over auto.
exposes.--aj-c-dest-ground: The ground of an unselected link that is not the last, over --paper-2.
exposes.--aj-c-dest-line: The keyline colour of an unselected link that is not the last, over --rule-2 (and --rule on hover).
exposes.--aj-c-dest-hover-decoration: The text-decoration of a hovered unselected link that is not the last, over none.
exposes.--aj-c-dest-hover-offset: The underline offset of that hover, over auto.
exposes.--aj-c-dest-slot: The display of the date slot (variant slot), over none.
exposes.--aj-c-dest-slot-column: The date slot's grid-column when the parent lays the row out as a grid.
exposes.--aj-c-dest-slot-row: The date slot's grid-row when the parent lays the row out as a grid.

states.default: yes: as rendered, the current destination filled
states.hover: yes: an unselected destination's keyline darkens to --rule (pointer devices only; transform-only ramp, no colour transition)
states.focus-visible: yes: the product's one focus ring (base)
states.active: yes: pressed 1px down, and scaled .97 under the shell's motion
states.disabled: n/a: a destination is never disabled
states.selected: yes: the current destination, aria-current="page", filled --block on --paper
states.leads back: yes: a script (scripts/journal-reflection.js) puts the back chevron (aj-c-dest__back, 12px, --s2 after it) first in Reflections on Timeline opened from a leaf's N entries and points it at that leaf's screen; it is taken away when Timeline is left. The row keeps its height.

a11y.keyboard: links in reading order; the current one is announced by aria-current

responsive.700: each destination takes its own width (padding --s7) instead of dividing the row
responsive.1200: in the title block: a column, You separated by --s7 (legacy context .title)

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css B1 (.dest, .dest.tab) and its contexts (title block, native tab bar, quiet navbar).
Behaviour round 3: the variant slot (the date slot) and the exposed properties the header sets for the quiet navbar; its legacy .quiet-navbar and .journal-header contexts are gone.
v4 B7: Reflections is a destination, next to Today (five links; current reflections). The pages share one list (system/content/destinations.mjs). The native tab bar is unchanged.

v4 C3: a destination that leads back wears the back chevron (aj-c-dest__back), added and removed by a script: Timeline's Reflections, when Timeline was opened from a leaf's N entries, replacing the back line in Timeline's masthead, which moved the navbar (explore/2026-10-28-timeline-back-position, e-reflections-tab).
